The main functions and controls of 3D Touch Auto Bed Leveling Sensor are the same as the usual auto bed leveling sensor, consisting of RC servo and microswitch. Thus, 3D Touch can be applied on almost every board.

3D Touch is fulfilled with simple structure and high precision by using progressively designed solenoid and hall sensors. It aims for user convenience and enjoyable printing by adding many smart functions, such as self-test, alarm, alarm release & Touch Switch mode, Blue LED for servo signal indicating and Z-probe (Zmin) Testing.​
3D Touch consists of Atmel ATtiny13A, solenoid, and a push pin.​

Innovative Solenoid: Ultra Power Saving In an idle state, while the push-pin is pulled out or retracted, there is no electric current flowing on the solenoid. Standby electric current in the whole device is below the average of 15mA on working state, but while the pin is moving, in a sudden about 100ms, under 300mA flows in the device. Low power consumption even drops joule heating, and it prevents heart problems.

Hall Sensor: Free Bed Selection 3D Touch does not use either optical or proximity(inductive/capacitive) sensors. 3D Touch is controlled by the hall effect, providing high precision. Thus, the bed material can be freely selected.
Optimized structure: Larger Build Size 3D Touch is a small, and technology-intensive device. Build size can be set larger than other existing auto bed leveling sensors.
Easy to Use: 3D Touch uses existing RC Servo motor signals intactly, so just plug 3D Touch on the same pins after removing the servo motor.
